BiblicalUsage: Aphekah is named once, among the towns of Judah in the hill country, listed between the valleys and the wilderness. A single mention on a map of the inheritance.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe even a town named once belongs to the story: the inheritance was counted town by town, and none of it was forgotten.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
